description: Turn on a capability slot such as email for a branch. When it needs the person's own credential, the answer holds a connect_url to hand to them; never ask for a key in chat. Then poll capabilities.status until live is true. Scope: projects:write.

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

provider.description: Who provides it: scribase (the platform, the default) or own (the person's own provider, entered on the connect page)

name: capabilities.add
title: Add a capability
